outline: This course presents a broad introduction to Environmental Engineering. This course will equip students with the discipline knowledge and problem-solving skills to design water, energy, shelter and primary production systems. From an environmental perspective, the student will learn how to develop an activity using various strategies to control, reduce and monitor all environmental problems that might arise as a result.
schedule:
1.	Introduction
2.	Mass and Energy Fundamentals
3.	Chemistry and Principles
4.	Microbiology and Microbial Growth
5.	Risk Assessment
6.	Water Quality and Treatment
7.	Air Pollution
8.	Solid Waste Management and Resource Recovery
9.	Global Climate Change
assessment: 40% Quizzes, 40% final exam, 20% Homework, 10% class participation.
